correctness.rationale: Every pebbling move decreases total pebble count by one, giving an exact induction on configuration size. A configuration is stackable iff it has single-vertex support or some legal child is stackable; reversing oriented moves gives an equivalent constructive recurrence. The included standard-library verifier enumerates every composition through t=8 on C5 and t=17 on C7 and independently compares exhaustive direct and backward recurrences at each level. At size 7 the C5 bad set equals the disjoint union of the two specified five-member dihedral orbits; at size 16 the C7 bad set equals the stated fourteen-member orbit. The next layers have no bad configurations. This is a rigorous finite exhaustive enumeration, not extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Csernak and Soukup 2026 give the stacking definition, a general exact recurrence and the numerical values stack(C5)=8 and stack(C7)=17, and their public code can generate witnesses. Those are explicitly excluded from novelty. The new assertion is an explicit labelled critical-obstruction orbit classification and contrast in almost-stacked structure: two five-member types on C5 (one non-almost-stacked) versus a single fourteen-member almost-stacked type on C7. The inspected full article, numerical report source, supplementary generic code and later ASH article do not state those orbit classes or their universal-versus-existential distinction. Exact searches did not locate a statement-level equivalent. Residual priority risk of implicit algorithmic coverage remains acknowledged.
residual_risks: Public generic source code may already emit all 14 and 10 critical configurations as raw lists; a prior unpublished/undocumented analysis may have grouped them into the same orbits.
No complete historical priority search across every graph-pebbling repository and terminology is possible.
No claim is made for cycles of order nine or greater; the finite table does not establish broader patterns.

value.rationale: This is not a new computation of known stacking thresholds. The explicit dihedral equality-case classification on the first two unresolved-shape odd cycles answers a natural structural question motivated by the Almost Stacked Hypothesis: C7 has a unique orbit of extremal configurations, all almost stacked, but C5 possesses an entire critical orbit with two piles of three. This demonstrates sharply that an existential almost-stacked principle cannot be strengthened to universal description even on a five-cycle. Natural complete classification of critical obstructions at the first nontrivial orders has intrinsic combinatorial value; no infinite extension is asserted.
